description.narrative:
NFPA has prepared a project proposal that contributes to their country program. The project aims to contribute to the creation of basic conditions for the population to be able to claim their sexual and reproductive rights and the right to a life without violence. The project will be implemented at national, district and municipal level during the period 2021- 2023 and has a budget of SEK 30 million. It is planned to be implemented in 14 municipalities in four districts, namely: Chuquisaca, Potosí, Cochabamba and Pando. The effort defines four results:
- Public policies regarding SRHR and freedom from gender-based violence are implemented. - Improved high-quality service regarding SRHR and gender-based violence as well as strengthened sex education are implemented. - Women's groups, indigenous peoples' groups and other civil society organizations exercise social control over SRHR. - The population demands protection of their sexual and reproductive rights and health.
This is to be achieved through policy dialogue, advocacy work, development of knowledge, skills development and strengthening of institutions. UNFPA will cooperate with relevant ministries and other institutions at national level as well as relevant authorities at district and municipal level. Civil society organizations will also be a partner.

UNFPA har utarbetat ett projektförslag som bidrar till deras landprogram. Projektet har som mål att bidra till att grundläggande förutsättningar skapas för att befolkningen ska kunna utkräva sina sexuella och reproduktiva rättigheter och rätten till ett liv utan våld. Projektet ska genomföras på nationell-, distrikts- och kommunal nivå under perioden 2017 - 2020 och har en budget på 60 MSEK. Det är planerat att genomföras i 14 kommuner i fyra distrikt, nämligen: Chuquisaca, Potosí, Cochabamba and Pando. Insatsen definierar fyra resultat:
- Offentliga policies avseende SRHR och frihet från könsbaserat våld implementeras. - Förbättrad service av hög kvalitet gällande SRHR och könsbaserat våld samt stärkt sexualundervisning implementeras. - Kvinnogrupper, ursprungsfolksgrupper och andra civilsamhällsorganisationer utövar social kontroll gällande SRHR. - Befolkningen utkräver skydd av sina sexuella och reproduktiva rättigheter och hälsa.
Detta ska åstadkommas genom policydialog, påverkansarbete, framtagande av kunskap, kompetenshöjning och stärkande av institutioner. UNFPA kommer att samarbeta med relevanta ministerier och andra institutioner på nationell nivå samt relevanta myndigheter på distrikts- och kommunal nivå. The programme shall contribute to UNFPA´s country programme in Bolivia. Specifically the program´s objective is that the population has and relies on public policies, services and knowledge that makes it possible for them to exercise their sexual and reproductive rights and the right to a life free of violence.

The results during 2019 are: Support to comprehensive differentiated and qualified Services for SRHR, Maternity Health Services and Gender Base Violence Services: - In 16 municipalities in the country 39 young counsels have been trained in SRHR Rigths. - 39 Municipalities have been strengthening in SRHR Rigths. - Public health, justice and education servers with strengthened capacities in integral SRHR care, adolescent pregnancy prevention, prevention and care, and punishment of gender-based violence with focus on gender, generational and intercultural approaches. Health care protocols and norms developed and implemented to improve sexual and reproductive health care practices: - New norms and protocols have been approved by the government and local municipalities. - Increased capacity within local municipalities and health systems at local level to carry out procedures aimed at improving the quality of care in public health services emphasizing maternal health, family planning, adolescents and youth as well as sexual gender based violence and HIV. Program for Prevention of Pregnancy: - Youth and adolescents Program against pregnancy have been approved at department level. Local civil society working with human rigths has been strengthening in LGBT, SRHR and indigenous peoples rigths in order to follow up the CEDAW recomendations: - Social organizations of women, adolescents, youth and indigenous people demanding their rigths and carring out social control the comunities and municipalities involved. Information system for SRHR: The creation of a tracking and information platform at municipalities in order to increase the capacity of the municipalities to monitor and follow up SRHR (39 municipalities have increased their capacity).
Long-term effect: Population, with emphasis on women, adolescents and young people exercise their SRHR and the right to live without violence. Medium-term effect: Population has public policies, services, mechanisms and skills that they contribute to the exercise of their SRHR and the right to a life free of violence. Short-term effect 1: Public policies on DSDR and a life free of gender-based violence, with emphasis in sexual violence in implementation. Short-term effect 2: Comprehensive differentiated and qualified services in SRH, EIS, GBV with an emphasis on strengthened sexual violence. Short-term effect 3: Social organizations of women, adolescents, youth and indigenous people carry out the social control and require the guarantors of rights to comply with their responsibilities in the face of DSDR and the right to a life free of gender-based violence, with an emphasis on sexual violence. Short-term effect 4: Population demands the protection of their SRHR and quality services in sexual health and reproductive health, comprehensive education for sexuality, prevention of pregnancy in adolescence and prevention, care, punishment of sexual violence. Based on information retrieved from final reports, evaluation reports, meetings or field visits the assessment is: The cooperation partner has adapted the program due to changes in the context and it has been very satisfactory in terms of outputs and lower level of objectives
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
